limitations_and_boundaries: Experiments were performed in mouse models; human relevance not directly tested.
Pre-plaque stage defined by absence of overt plaques; early synaptic changes may not fully represent later stages.
C1q antibody ANX-M1 characterized in vitro; in vivo pharmacokinetics not detailed.
Synapse loss measured by colocalized puncta; functional synapse counts not directly assessed.
Microglial engulfment assay relies on Homer-GFP reporter; may not capture all synaptic material.
Causal chain tested in separate models (J20, APP/PS1, oAβ injection); consistency across models assumed.
No direct evidence that C1q/C3/CR3 pathway is the only mechanism of early synapse loss.
